visual.title: Stationarity, feasibility, sign
visual.caption: A KKT point is primal feasible, stationary against the active normals, and has nonnegative multipliers. The figure solves those multipliers from the drawn gradient and normals.

predict.question: At the optimum, what are the signs of the two resource multipliers?
predict.explain: The multipliers are 1/3 and 4/3. Both are positive, so increasing either bound can improve the objective, and the gradient is their nonnegative combination.
